classification.observed_reason: AFFLIB could not create and sign the image

classification.observed_reason: charybdis did not listen or greet over TLS
classification.evidence: both subjects L5. charybdis refuses to run as euid 0: ircd/ircd.c:636 `if (geteuid() == 0)` -> `Don't run ircd as root!!!`; the court container runs as root.
classification.next_action: needs a controlled privilege-drop seam in the venue, not a crate fix

classification.observed_reason: DMA did not deliver the message over TLS
classification.evidence: both subjects L5-loaded; the admitted local workload fails identically under authority and candidate: DMA did not deliver the message over TLS

classification.observed_reason: fastd's data path requires a TUN interface; the court container has no /dev/net/tun device and no CAP_NET_ADMIN (TUNSETIFF is refused), so the two-peer handshake workload cannot run in this venue
classification.evidence: both subjects L6-runtime; the data path needs a TUN device / CAP_NET_ADMIN and the container has no /dev/net/tun.
classification.next_action: out of scope for this venue

classification.observed_reason: h2o did not serve the fixture over TLS
classification.smallest_observed_region: consumer h2o: lib/core/util.c h2o_accept -> h2o_socket_ssl_handshake (and lib/common/socket.c create_ossl/SSL_accept); the candidate never reaches SSL_new
classification.evidence: authority L7-functional, candidate L5-loaded.  A versioned LD_PRELOAD trace of the candidate build shows SSL_CTX_new, SSL_CTX_use_certificate_chain_file=1, SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey=1 and SSL_CTX_callback_ctrl(63/72)=1, but no SSL_new/SSL_accept when a client connects; the listener accepts and closes before the handshake starts.
classification.next_action: queue for the next conversion/bugfix wave; inspect the candidate SSL_CTX callback/state wiring used by a server listener (not a harness or source-unreachable failure)
classification.candidate_region: not yet pinned to a src/ line: the instrumented candidate build shows the failure occurs before SSL_new, after SSL_CTX setup returns success, so the next probe should start at the server SSL_CTX/listener wiring
